I take part in the following collaborative research projects, funded by national,
international and local programmes, with academic and industrial partners.

## Current projects

- **OPTIMA-DTMS** — Optimal Maintenance of Systemic Digital Twins of Manufacturing Systems (2026–2030)\
    *ANR PRCE · LURPA (coord.), Systemic Intelligence Group · budget 497.6 k€*\
    Methods and tools to update the digital twin of a production system when the system evolves, at a cost far below that of its initial design.
- **[CHAAT](https://ulifahrenberg.github.io/chaat/)** — Concurrency and Higher-dimensional Automata: Applications and Theory (2026–2030)\
    *ANR PRC · LMF (coord.), LRE (EPITA), IRIF, LIX (École polytechnique), SAMOVAR (Télécom SudParis) · budget 672.5 k€*\
    Theory and tools for higher-dimensional automata, a model of non-interleaving concurrency, with applications to verification and concurrent controllers.
- **Reverse engineering of PLC-based systems** — CIFRE PhD with EDF R&D (2026–2029)\
    *ANRT CIFRE · EDF R&D, LURPA*\
    A formal approach to the reverse engineering of timed logic systems based on programmable logic controllers.
- **ADAM** — Automatic behaviour deviation detection by adaptive modelling (2025–2026)\
    *Université Paris-Saclay, Poc in Labs prematuration programme (IDEX) · LURPA · budget 80 k€*\
    Software that automatically builds and updates a behavioural digital twin of a production line from its sensor and actuator signals, to detect faults and cyber-attacks early in a form operators can interpret. It builds on the PhD work of Yan Monier, co-leader of the project, who received the [2026 i-PhD award](https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/actualites/prix-i-lab-et-i-phd-11-projets-laureats-lies-luniversite-paris-saclay) (French Ministry of Research and Bpifrance) for ADAM.
- **WiFine RPM** — Remote patient monitoring with Wi-Fi sensing (2025–2027)\
    *SATT Paris-Saclay maturation programme · CentraleSupélec, MICS (coord.), LURPA, [Zoe Care](https://zoe.care/)*\
    Turning ordinary Wi-Fi devices into sensors that recognise movements, locate people and measure breathing at home, for remote medical monitoring. The technology is developed with [Zoe Care](https://zoe.care/), a start-up from CentraleSupélec research whose first product, Zoe Fall, detects falls of older people from Wi-Fi waves.

## Past projects

- **VALIDATOR** — Evaluation and optimization of clinical pathways using formal methods (2022–2024)\
    *Spanish State Research Agency (AEI), Ecological and Digital Transition programme · University of Zaragoza (coord.), Clinical Hospital of Zaragoza, Université Paris-Saclay, University of Cagliari · budget 115 k€*\
    Petri net models of clinical pathways, built with the physicians of the Clinical Hospital of Zaragoza, to evaluate them and shorten hospital stays.
- **PRECAPPAQUO** — Preventing depressive disorders through everyday gestures with a communicating patch sensor (2020–2021)\
    *Labex LaSIPS · GEEPS (coord.), LURPA, C2N*
- **[Exoman](https://www.exoman.universite-paris-saclay.fr)** — Towards exoskeleton-human symbiosis: investigating how humans interact with an upper-limb robotic exoskeleton (2019–2024)\
    *ANR · CIAMS (coord.), CEA List, ISIR, LURPA · budget 562.9 k€*
- **ProMAut** — Process Mining and System Identification in Automatic Control (2019–2020)\
    *Institut Farman (FR CNRS 3311) · LURPA, LSV*
- **Franco-Bavarian project** — Artificial Intelligence techniques for fault detection and activity recognition in the context of Ambient Assisted Living (2017–2019)\
    *Bavarian-French University Cooperation Centre (BFHZ-CCUFB) · LURPA, Technical University of Munich*
- **ITSCABA** — Identification of a task supervised by ambient binary sensors (2017–2018)\
    *Institut Farman (FR CNRS 3311) · LURPA, CMLA*
- **5P** — Personalised participatory prevention pathway (2016–2020)\
    *CGSS La Réunion, IDEX Sorbonne Paris Cité · Cognac-G and IRD (coord.), CMLA, LURPA, CHU La Réunion, CCAS La Réunion, SATT IdF Innov, ENGIE Ineo Digital*\
    Assessing the mobility of frail people to personalise their care pathway; the home-monitoring algorithms developed in the project were industrialised by ENGIE Ineo Digital in its Smartflat product.
- **CARNAVAL** — Ambient sensors for activity recognition and monitoring at the Val-de-Grâce hospital (2016–2017)\
    *Institut Farman (FR CNRS 3311) · LURPA, CMLA*
